activity.notes: George III was King of the separate Kingdom of Great Britain from his accession on 25 October 1760 until the union with Ireland took effect on 1 January 1801. His post-Union kingship is already recorded under the United Kingdom.

sources.title: George III — UK Parliament Regnal Years
sources.citation_text: UK Parliament records George III's reign over the Kingdom of Great Britain from 25 October 1760 to 1 January 1801, followed by the United Kingdom from 1 January 1801.
